text: I can explain why consensus needs a majority and size a cluster for a given number of tolerated failures.
I can walk through a Raft leader election step by step, including terms, votes and split votes.
I can explain when a Raft entry is committed and estimate commit latency from follower round trips.
I can explain how the election restriction keeps committed entries safe and why leaders must confirm leadership before reads.
I can describe Paxos's two phases and how Multi-Paxos relates to Raft.
I can design leader election or a lock on etcd or ZooKeeper and say what data does not belong there.
